truths.truth: A seam counts the criteria ceilings both grammars state, admits both roadmap heading spellings, and never reports a pass for a surface that declared nothing
truths.evidence: `planning.mjs criteria-size --phase 4 --context-min 3 --context-max 7 --roadmap-min 2 --roadmap-max 5` -> {"context_criteria":7,"roadmap_criteria":5,"compared":[4 bounds],"within":true}; `--phase 2 --roadmap-min 2 --roadmap-max 5` -> over:[{"kind":"roadmap-criteria-too-many","measured":6,"ceiling":5}]; `--phase 6` -> {"roadmap_found":false,"compared":[],"within":null} (never ok-with-nothing-compared). Wired at three call sites: cadence-core/workflows/context.md:353 (3-7), new-project.md:305 and adopt.md:200 (2-5). Both spellings carry a test row each: planning-files.test.mjs:707 (`**Success Criteria:**`) and :712 (bare `Success criteria:`); dispatch arm planning.mjs:3647 -> cmdCriteriaSize; parser lib/planning-files.mjs:437 phaseCriteria.

truths.truth: `trace close` writes the terminal, all eight restating files call it, and the BRACKETING census reddens on a raw terminal append put back
truths.evidence: Behavior run on a temp dir: `trace close --phase 1 --plan 1 --role cad-executor --tokens 100` writes {"family":"lifecycle","event":"return"}, the same line with `--detail "budget burned"` writes {"event":"checkpoint"} - the seam, not the prose, picks the arm. Tree-wide grep for `trace append --event return|checkpoint` under cadence-core/ skills/ agents/ returns ZERO invocations (only a quoted mention inside seam-calls.test.mjs:78). BRACKETING (trace.test.mjs:1100-1109) carries all eight rows: context.md, plan.md, plan-revision.md, review-triggers.md, execute.md, decision-review.md, minimalism-review.md, verify-deep.md, asserted EQUALS not at-least (:1261). Mutation-proved in a scratchpad copy: appending one raw `trace append --family lifecycle --event return` line to verify-deep.md turned trace.test.mjs from 84 pass/0 fail to 83 pass/1 fail with 'a restated raw append is the spelling this census exists to refuse'.

truths.truth: `trace render`'s default response carries no events array, is >=3x smaller, still carries every outcome and one row per bracket, and the full array sits behind a flag with a CONTRACTS row
truths.evidence: Re-measured: `trace render --phase 3` = 9,890 B, `--phase 3 --events` = 36,916 B - 3.73x, both figures exactly as SUMMARY claims. Default keys are [ok,file,corr,capped,counts,roles,coordinator,brackets,outcomes,unpaired]; 'events' in o === false. Completeness re-measured rather than assumed: the `--events` payload holds 164 events of which 15 are family `outcome`, and the default `outcomes` array is length 15 - every outcome event, none dropped - and includes the `rearm` the triage gate looks up. brackets length 31. CONTRACTS row self-verify.mjs:275 `'trace render': ['--phase','--events']`, and self-verify reports 0 problems (so no unknown-flag).

truths.truth: The two measured round-trips are batched in prose and a census pins the per-workflow invocation count, reddening when a call comes back
truths.evidence: cadence-core/workflows/context.md:85-86 is ONE wrapped `config.mjs get memory.backend planning.commit_docs`; workflows/plan.md:358-369 issues seed-reqs and `cursor set` under 'both in ONE message. No value flows from the first into the second'. Census cadence-core/bin/seam-calls.test.mjs pins context.md=6 and plan.md=9 with the derivation in its header, plus a not-dead test (:83) proving the counter joins continuations and ignores backticked prose. Mutation-proved in a scratchpad copy: adding one `config.mjs get planning.commit_docs` call to context.md turned it 2 pass/1 fail. CAVEAT, already disclosed in SUMMARY Open items: ROADMAP criterion 4's wording says the per-workflow count DROPS; plan.md dropped 11->9 but context.md is FLAT 6->6 (the batching removed a round trip, not a call, and this phase's own criteria-size call added one back). The UAT item's expected text and CONTEXT AC4 are fully met; the ROADMAP phrasing must not be restated as-is by phase 5/6.

truths.truth: A reads.jsonl record joins to the trace.jsonl bracket that caused it on committed fixtures, reports ambiguous on overlapping same-role brackets and the unjoinable floor as a count, with report.md prose and the CONTRACTS row moved
truths.evidence: Committed fixtures exist and are tracked: cadence-core/bin/fixtures/join.reads.jsonl, join.trace.jsonl. read-trace.test.mjs:592 runs the real seam over them and fixes all eight records exactly: calls 8 = joined 2 + ambiguous 1 + unjoined 2 + floor 2 + coordinator 1 + unresolved 0, asserted as a partition (:613); :494-497 pins the overlapping same-role case to status 'ambiguous' rather than a picked bracket; :506 pins the HOST_AGENT_TYPES floor. Live run `planning.mjs reads --join` returns joined 1391 / ambiguous 85 / unjoined 12 / floor 553 / coordinator 1107 / unresolved 0. CONTRACTS row moved: self-verify.mjs:246 `reads: ['--join']`. Prose moved: workflows/report.md:22 invokes `reads --join`, :33 documents the six figures, and the old 'takes no phase scoping and no flag' sentence is gone tree-wide (grep returns only two source comments, no shipped prose). read-trace.test.mjs:545-556 also covers the unparsable-timestamp and no-bracket paths.

truths.truth: The cad-executor dispatch hands over the resolve's answered surfaces, the contract states what the executor does with them, and a test asserts it on the dispatch payload
truths.evidence: cadence-core/workflows/execute.md:168-171 puts the resolved `surfaces` on the stable-first half of the dispatch prompt and states the `surfaces_answered: false` meaning (ALL categories stand, not none). skills/cad-executor-contract/SKILL.md:19-23 states the use - the bar the work is WRITTEN to, explicitly NOT a halt condition. Test on the payload: prose-agreement.test.mjs (added in e04dcc2) slices the execute_sequential prompt between its step marker and the 'Do NOT restate' line and asserts both /`surfaces`/ and /surfaces_answered/, then asserts the contract names no surface config.schema.json does not carry. Parallel path inherits it: references/execute-parallel.md:15 'Same prompt as sequential except the mode line'. Whole suite green, so this test passes.

truths.evidence: One full-suite run, `node --test cadence-core/bin/*.test.mjs`: exit 0, tests 1790 / pass 1790 / fail 0 / cancelled 0 / skipped 0 / todo 0 - SUMMARY's 1,790/0 re-measured and confirmed. `node cadence-core/bin/self-verify.mjs` -> {"ok":true,...,"problems":[]} across 21 checks including budgets, script-contracts and config-keys, so no unbudgeted-surface, budget-overrun, unknown-flag or config-key failure. `npx tsc -p tsconfig.ci.json` produced no diagnostics.

truths.truth: criteria-size's roadmap parser reports a phase's real criteria count rather than a fence-inflated one
truths.evidence: Reproduced directly on a synthetic roadmap: a `### Phase 1:` block declaring TWO criteria, followed by a fenced ``` example containing a six-item `Success criteria:` list, is reported as {"roadmap_criteria":8,"over":[{"kind":"roadmap-criteria-too-many","measured":8,"ceiling":5}],"within":false} - a compliant surface reported out of range. Parser: cadence-core/bin/lib/planning-files.mjs:437 phaseCriteria. Not firing on this repo today (its ROADMAP carries no fenced criteria example inside a phase block) and not on cadence-core/templates/ROADMAP.md (no `### Phase N:` blocks at all, so it reports phases:[]), and SUMMARY's Open items discloses it honestly - but it is a live false positive on any user roadmap that shows a criteria example inside a phase block, and phase 3 shipped COR-01 specifically to guard fence-blind scanners.

gaps.name: criteria-size mis-counts a roadmap phase that shows a fenced criteria example
gaps.reason: behavior wrong - phaseCriteria is fence-blind, so numbered items inside a ``` block are counted as the phase's own criteria and a compliant phase is reported out of range
gaps.evidence: cadence-core/bin/lib/planning-files.mjs:437 phaseCriteria. Reproduced: a `### Phase 1:` block with a real 2-item `Success criteria:` list followed by a fenced 6-item example returns {"roadmap_criteria":8,"over":[{"kind":"roadmap-criteria-too-many","measured":8,"ceiling":5}],"within":false}. Not firing on this repo's own ROADMAP.md or on cadence-core/templates/ROADMAP.md, and disclosed in SUMMARY.md's Open items - but AC1's promise is that an out-of-range report means something, and phase 3 shipped COR-01 to guard exactly this fence-blindness elsewhere.
gaps.missing: Strip fenced blocks before counting inside a phase block (reuse phase 3's COR-01 fence-skipping helper), and add a phaseCriteria test row asserting a fenced example does not inflate the count.
